title: Acceptance probability of a mixture component
statement: Let $t>0$, and let $T_0,\ldots,T_{t-1}$ be nonadaptive testers with the same domain, codomain, and number of queries. For a function $f$ and real numbers $\mathrm{rate}$ and $\varepsilon$, if the uniform mixture of these testers accepts $f$ with probability at least $1-(\mathrm{rate}/t)\varepsilon$, then every component $T_i$ accepts $f$ with probability at least $1-\mathrm{rate}\,\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A family of $t$ nonadaptive testers with common domain, codomain, and query count
A function from the common domain to the common codomain
The mixture acceptance probability is at least $1-(\mathrm{rate}/t)\varepsilon$
